rappel_detail.pull: Short and plumb. Reports differ on the rope: some found a 30 m rope just enough, another needed most of a 40 m rope. Carry 40 m for margin.
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel down the summit pitch to the top of the 3rd-class scramble. Parties who prefer to downclimb the pitch skip it.
rappel_detail.anchor: old pitons plus a fixed cam or sling; check and back up
hazards: The anchor is weathered alpine hardware, not bolts. Inspect the slings before weighting them.
A moat just below the summit rocks may need a snow bridge to cross.
rappel_detail.station: Mount Challenger's summit block, at the top of the short 5.5-5.7 summit pitch.

set.rappels: 1 rappel on the descent, off Mount Challenger's summit block after traversing the ridge; no rappels on Poltergeist Pinnacle itself
set.rappel_count_note: One short rappel off the summit block is the only rappel on the descent; many parties downclimb it instead. Reports differ on rope length, from a 30 m rope being just enough to a 40 m rope being needed, so carry 40 m. The length of the rappel is not published.
